purpose: Before any self-gravity science run, map the frozen E9 CLASS background exactly into pinned SWIFT conventions and calibrate the equal neutrino macro-particle mass for the fundamental k=0.05 h/Mpc box with 32^3 PartType6 particles.

calibration_background.note: Omega_cdm=Omega_b=0 only for this calibration run because only Omega_nu0 and Omega_r and the PartType6 macro mass are being extracted. These are independent of the chosen Omega_lambda/Omega_k. Full E9 matter densities are imposed only after closure is computed.

outputs: flat Omega_lambda = 1 - Omega_b - Omega_cdm - Omega_r - Omega_nu_0
calibrated equal PartType6 macro mass for L and 32^3 particles
interpretation: Engineering/cosmology closure only; no self-gravity hidden-state response is measured.
